label: challenging
title: Clear control trigger with vague IP liability

pages.text:
RESEARCH COLLABORATION

Between Alloy Labs and Basalt Pharma.

Section 2. Change of Control. If either party undergoes a change of control, the collaboration pauses until the other party consents in writing.

Section 6. Liability. Liability for intellectual property claims shall be determined under applicable law. All other liability is capped at project funding.

Signed. Signature: Ed Pond. Signature: Fay Marsh.

evidence.quote: If either party undergoes a change of control, the collaboration pauses until the other party consents in writing.

expected.rationale: The control-change trigger is clear, but the intellectual-property liability sentence states neither a cap nor unlimited language, so flagging uncapped_liability is defensible but uncertain. needs_legal_review for the liability question.
